items.meta_description: Download VpnHood! CLIENT for Android, Android TV, Windows, or Linux. The app has no built-in VPN servers — you need an access key from whoever runs the server.
items.page_desc: Fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by VpnHood! ENGINE, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
items.notice_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT does not include any VPN servers of its own, so it cannot connect to anything on its own. You need an access key from whoever runs the server — paste it into the app once and you are connected.
items.direct_link_note: It's best to download with the direct link only when you don't have access to Google Play.
